entry.title: Warm weather thwarts Old Navy recovery, as Gap continues to shine
entry.summary: As the Gap Inc.’s value brand falters, its namesake has risen from a years-long slump to notch its 12th straight quarter of comparable sales growth.

entry.title: The Container Store is back online after cybersecurity incident
entry.summary: The incident has not impacted the security of customer financial data, according to the company.

entry.title: Retail’s fastest AI return right now sits behind the storefront
entry.summary: Shopper-facing AI gets the headlines. The faster return comes from fixing what sits underneath.

entry.title: Why retailers prefer real human expertise over automated payment support
entry.summary: When payment issues hit during peak season, automation isn’t enough.

entry.title: How Home Depot built the missing logistics piece for its Pro business
entry.summary: Through new flatbed distribution centers, acquisitions and technology, the home improvement retailer has enhanced its last-mile delivery capabilities to better serve contractor customers.

entry.title: David’s Bridal tests dress rental
entry.summary: The retailer’s Something Borrowed program is being piloted at 11 stores in Pennsylvania.

entry.title: Backcountry acquires winter sports retailer Christy Sports
entry.summary: The deal creates a combined retail footprint of more than 60 locations and expands owner CSC Generation’s brand portfolio with a large ski and snowboard rental network.

entry.title: Amazon enlists customers in fight against NYC delivery worker bill
entry.summary: The e-commerce giant released a call to action for city customers to speak out against The Delivery Protection Act, or face increased order costs of up to $5.

entry.title: Majority of states now battling Dollar General over pricing practices
entry.summary: Ten states joined the Federal Trade Commission and 20 other states in a complaint filed last month alleging deceptive pricing.

entry.title: Black Friday, Cyber Monday shopping projected to slip
entry.summary: Shoppers will scoop up deals during Thanksgiving weekend, but extended sales events have enticed consumers to start holiday shopping early, according to the National Retail Federation.
